title: Chart quiz #17
caption:
Chart quiz #17. Lock in your answers before the reveal.

Q1: Bounce or break?
Q2: Name the pattern
Q3: Where does the take-profit go?

Each chart pauses so you can comment your answer, then plays on to show what happened, and why.

Tell me your score: 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Practise reading charts at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

#MemeStreet #ChartQuiz #SupportAndResistance #ChartPatterns #LearnToTrade
narration: Three charts. Three new skills to test. Levels, patterns and targets. Question one. Price is testing resistance for the third time. Bounce, or break? It held. The last push was weaker, on lower volume, and the level was defended again. That's no promise it holds next time. Question two. Three peaks, with the middle one highest. What's the pattern? Head and shoulders, cup and handle, or double bottom? Head and shoulders. A left shoulder, a higher head, a lower right shoulder, and then the neckline gave way. It's a bearish pattern, but only once that neckline breaks. Question three. You bought near the bottom of the range. Where does your take-profit go? A, B, or C? A, just below the old resistance. C cuts a good trade short, and B sits beyond a level that's turned price away before, so it may never fill. How many did you get? Tell me your score in the comments. Practise on real charts from the game, at memestreet.net.
